Vectorized calculation of fast within-set statistics

calculate_in_stats_fast_vectorized.Rd

Calculates fast within-set statistics for a collection of sets using vectorized algorithm.

Usage

calculate_in_stats_fast_vectorized(object, sets_dt, set_membership_dt)

# S4 method for class 'ECProb'
calculate_in_stats_fast_vectorized(object, sets_dt, set_membership_dt)

Arguments

object

An ECProb object.

sets_dt

A data table with a single column ("set_id")

set_membership_dt

A data table with "set_id" and "element" columns.

Value

A data table with edge-count stattistics (`observed_edge_count`, `lambda`, etc.).

Methods (by class)

  • calculate_in_stats_fast_vectorized(ECProb): Method for ECProb objects

Examples

# Create sample data
library(data.table)
ecg <- ECGraph(data.frame(p1=c("E1","E3"), p2=c("E2","E4")))
ecp <- ECProb(ecg)
sets <- data.table(set_id = c("SA", "SB"))
memberships <- data.table(
  set_id = c("SA","SA","SA","SB","SB"),
  element = c("E1","E2","E3","E3","E4")
)
# Run vectorized calculation
calculate_in_stats_fast_vectorized(ecp, sets, memberships)
#>    set_id observed_edge_count lambda   p_value log2_Anscombe_ratio set_size
#>    <char>               <int>  <num>     <num>               <num>    <int>
#> 1:     SA                   1   0.75 0.5241636           0.1447533        3
#> 2:     SB                   1   0.25 0.2000000           0.5687518        2
#>    max_possible_edges
#>                 <num>
#> 1:                  3
#> 2:                  1
